generation_policy.candidate_source: open-vocabulary claim and operation segmentation of the public chip
hard_constraints: chip provenance for every factual node
abstract length must fall in the style-profile band
generation_policy.weight_interpretation: Normalized qualitative posterior mass from evidence coverage, dependency coherence, abstract utility, and complexity; these are loop-1 inference weights, not learned cross-paper probabilities.

hypotheses.label: Converging capability and hardware gaps with branched mechanism validation
hypotheses.structural_signature: two roots -> one method hub -> three mechanism branches -> three heterogeneous validation leaves -> bounded synthesis, plus one caveat leaf

evidence_reasons.reason: The chip explicitly binds capability and hardware gaps to recurrence, complex-state, and MIMO changes.
Independent language-modeling, formal-state, and latency outcomes support a branched rather than single-chain trace.
The retrieval limitation prevents an unqualified synthesis.

hypotheses.weight_reason: Highest coverage of the abstract-worthy quality, mechanism, and efficiency evidence with one explicit limitation; moderate complexity is justified by the chip's three distinct validation streams.

hypotheses.label: Mechanism-first ablation fan-in
hypotheses.structural_signature: three independent mechanism roots -> three matched ablation or benchmark branches -> one architecture-level inference

evidence_reasons.reason: The chip exposes unusually specific component ablations and formal-task comparisons.
MIMO has both an incremental quality result and a distinct latency profile.

hypotheses.weight_reason: Strong causal-artifact fit, but it gives less space to the motivating deployment gap and retrieval boundary than H1.

hypotheses.label: Deployment Pareto trace with retrieval-risk mitigation
hypotheses.structural_signature: one deployment root -> quality/latency Pareto fork; parallel retrieval-risk root -> hybrid mitigation -> cost join

evidence_reasons.reason: The chip directly frames recurrent decode as memory-bound and MIMO as an arithmetic-intensity intervention.
Kernel and end-to-end results reveal different SISO/MIMO quality-latency choices.
Retrieval recovery is conditional because hybrid attention adds cost.

hypotheses.weight_reason: Operationally distinctive and caveat-aware, but too deployment-centered to cover the full language-model and state-tracking contribution in a short abstract.

hypotheses.label: Implementation-upward realization trace
hypotheses.structural_signature: four code-anchor roots -> implementation join -> method realization -> test and latency leaves

evidence_reasons.reason: The official implementation maps distinct SISO, MIMO, and decode paths to inspected kernels.
Variable-length tests and H100 latency give executable grounding.

hypotheses.weight_reason: Highly auditable but implementation-heavy for the target abstract style and insufficiently representative of the central quality evidence.

selection.selection_basis: Best joint evidence coverage and abstract utility under the recommended length band, while retaining the retrieval boundary and avoiding a universal linear writing route.
